d: Australian cricket is facing fresh ball-tampering allegations, reopening the controversy surrounding the infamous 2018 Sandpapergate scandal. A new report claims Australian players discussed using mints to alter the condition of the ball during the first Test against Pakistan in Dubai in October 2018, just months after the Cape Town incident. Former coach Justin Langer and then-captain Tim Paine reportedly intervened to stop the plan. Langer is also said to have delivered a furious dressing-room reprimand over the proposal.
